# Nodedr POS

> Self-hosted retail point-of-sale by NodeDR: barcode checkout, inventory, returns, customer credit, configurable currencies and GST. A scoped REST API and MCP endpoint let an online store read SKU-linked stock and send click-and-collect orders or bills. Requires the shop to run its own instance.

## Integrate

- [Custom online store guide](https://github.com/Raktim94/nodedr-pos/blob/master/docs/CUSTOM_STORE.md)
